title: IVG Original Salts Tropical Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Tropical Ice 10ml E-Liquid brings a bright, exotic fusion of sun-ripened tropical fruits to your palate. This expertly crafted blend delivers a complex mix of sweet, juicy notes that immediately evoke the character of a tropical escape. To enhance the vibrancy of the fruit, a brisk, cooling Ice finish is added to the exhale, providing a clean and refreshing contrast that cuts through the tropical sweetness. It is a bright, multi-faceted profile that remains consistently satisfying. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the exotic Tropical Ice, vapers can explore other stellar options like the vibrant Blue Blaze or the tangy Riberry Lemonade. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
